description: How many uniform cartons fit in a shipping container before cube-out or weigh-out. Presets: 20GP (33.2 CBM nominal, 28,200 kg payload), 40GP (67.7 CBM, 26,700 kg), 40HC (76.4 CBM, 68 usable, 26,500 kg) — all editable. Returns max pieces by volume vs weight, the binding limit, balanced density (kg/m3) and containers needed for a planned quantity.

cbm_per_piece.description: Volume per carton in CBM (alternative to dimensions)

payload_kg.description: Override max payload (kg); route limits are often lower than the container maximum

planned_qty.description: Planned number of cartons (returns containers needed)

name: container_loading
